shots.speaker: ANCHOR
shots.text: Interim President Vasile takes the oath this morning, on the steps of the old courthouse.

shots.speaker: VASILE
shots.text: We owe this morning to soldiers whose names you will never know.
Biribel in the crowd. Maru beside him on crutches. Bodi and Alex a row behind.
Vasile finds Biribel in the crowd. A tiny nod.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: Gabi, Seby, Darius. Volkov. The country's free. I wanted to tell you that.

shots.speaker: BIRIBEL
shots.text: I didn't want to tell you who's holding it.
